dbspec.name: SensaCustomerScore
dbspec.source-query: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID as CustomerID, (select max(start_date) from amlorch_job_run where domain_code ='SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY' and process_name ='SENSA_MONTHLY_Processing' and status in ('RUNNING') ) as RunTimestamp, coalesce ((select orgunit_code from customers c1 where c1.customer_id = scs.customer_id),'GRO') as OrganisationalUnit, OVERALL_RISK_SCORE as OverallRiskScore, ANOMALY_DETECTION_SCORE as AnomalyDetectionScore, CHANGE_BEHAVIOUR_SCORE as ChangeInBehaviourScore, HOTSPOT_SCORE as HotspotScore FROM V_SM_SENSA_CUSTOMER_SCORE scs ) V_SM_SENSA_CUSTOMER_SCORE WHERE @WHERE@
